title: Use a workflow of Your Image → Custom GPT Image 2.0 Storyboard → Seedance 2.0…
content: Use a workflow of Your Image → Custom GPT Image 2.0 Storyboard → Seedance 2.0 to turn a single image into clean, professional storyboard prompts for video generation.
